ratios.facility: 2026 Debt Agreements (2026 Term Loan and 2026 Revolver)
ratios.quote: as well as a financial covenant to maintain a maximum consolidated net leverage ratio (calculated net of up to $ 1.0 billion of unrestricted cash and cash equivalents) of 3.50 to 1.00 , subject to an increase, at our election (which may be made up to three times), to 4.00 to 1.00 for each of the four fiscal quarters following a material acquisition.

parsed.notes: The filing states only the covenant limit and that the company was in compliance as of September 30, 2026; it does not disclose the actual ratio. Net leverage is calculated net of up to $1.0 billion of unrestricted cash. At the company's election (up to three times), the limit can step up to 4.00x for four quarters after a material acquisition; the excerpt does not say whether this was elected. The consolidated leverage ratio that sets the interest margin is a pricing grid, not a covenant, so it is excluded.
